title: Report: Nintendo slashes Switch 2 production by a third due to weak U.S. sales forecasts
content: Nintendo has reportedly downgraded Switch 2 production from 6 million units to 4 million units, a reduction of roughly one third, due to weaker-than-expected U.S. sales demand. The report comes ahead of the console's launch and suggests Nintendo is taking a more conservative approach following concerns about consumer price sensitivity in the North American market.
